subject: Post-incident technical closure, RCA highlights, and evidence/verification request
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@streamlinepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Post-incident technical closure, RCA highlights, and evidence/verification request

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Attached is a concise customer-facing RCA and a short evidence bundle (timeline logs + mitigation checklist). Key points up front:

- Incident summary (one-line): An inference-cache invalidation race during a rolling config change caused a small percentage of in-flight sessions to return stale KV-state, leading to garbled responses for ~0.6% of requests between 05:12–05:47 UTC on Dec 14.
- Root cause: a previously untested concurrency window in the KV cache invalidation logic combined with a delayed cache-eviction task under high-batch pressure.
- Customer impact: brief content misalignment for some inference sessions; no exfiltration of customer data; no model compromise.

Timeline (high-level):
- 05:12 UTC: config rollout begins (automated canary).
- 05:18 UTC: first anomaly spike — elevated error signatures for chat sessions.
- 05:22 UTC: autoscaling kicks in; cache-eviction queue backlog grows.
- 05:34 UTC: mitigation (rollback of config) initiated; traffic falls back to stable model variant.
- 05:47 UTC: metrics normalize.

Action items we are committing to (owners & ETA):
1) Patch KV invalidation to add a per-session semaphore and deterministic eviction ordering — owner: David Kim — ETA: 2027-12-20
2) Add end-to-end test for concurrent eviction windows in CI — owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2027-12-22
3) Expanded retention of telemetry for 30 days for impacted accounts for verification — owner: Hannah Schmitt — ETA: 2027-12-16
4) Offer a 1:1 verification session with your engineering team and deliver a signed evidence packet once patch is applied — owner: Priya Natarajan — ETA: schedule by 2027-12-17

Attached: 20271214-streamlinepay-rca.pdf (summary), timeline-logs-20271214.csv (anonymized traces), mitigation-checklist.xlsx (owner matrix).

Next steps for Streamline Pay: please confirm whether you’d like the verification call before or after the patch goes live (we recommend after patch + automated tests are in place so we can walk through live evidence).

If you want one-sentence text for execs: “Redwood identified a KV cache invalidation race during a config rollout, rolled back to a stable variant within 35 minutes, and is delivering a patch + CI tests and evidence for customer verification.”

Thanks — we’ll follow up internally to get evidence artifacts ready.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0194

[attachment stubs: 20271214-streamlinepay-rca.pdf (4 pages), timeline-logs-20271214.csv (CSV, 1.2MB), mitigation-checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Elena Morris <elena@streamlinepay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-incident technical closure, RCA highlights, and evidence/verification request

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear summary and the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying questions before we schedule verification:

1) Can you confirm whether the stale KV reads could occur during cross-region failover? Our traffic sometimes shifts between us-west and eu-west pools.
2) For the patch (per-session semaphore), will that introduce any additional tail latency in worst-case contention? We need to understand perf impact.
3) For the evidence packet, we’d like a signed artifact from an engineering lead confirming the patch and the commit hash for audit.

If you can reply with short answers to 1–3 and a proposed time for a 30-minute verification call (our preference: morning PST on Fri 12/17), we’ll confirm.

—Elena
Elena Morris
Lead Customer Engineer, Streamline Pay
elena@streamlinepay.com

Subject: Fwd: Post-incident technical closure, RCA highlights, and evidence/verification request

Team — forwarding Elena's questions. Short asks:
- Cross-region behavior: is the invalidation race possible across pool handoffs or was it strictly local to a node-level eviction ordering? (David)
- Perf impact: expected tail-latency delta with per-session semaphore under simulated load (p95/p99) and any mitigations (Marissa)
- Evidence: please prepare a signed confirmation (engineer + tech lead) with commit hash and CI run id. Hannah, flag telemetry we must retain and a way to export sanitized traces.

Elena prefers Fri morning PST for verification if we can have patch live + evidence by then. Can we meet those ETAs?

Priya
(prioritize patch/telemetry retention)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <elena@streamlinepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-incident technical closure, RCA highlights, and evidence/verification request

Hi Elena — quick update and answers to 1–3 below. We’ve attached the signed evidence packet and links to the CI run and commit.

1) Cross-region: the race was node-local to the eviction queue and does not cross region boundaries. Our rolling config change was executed independently per pool; failover between regions triggers a fresh session-state initialization so stale KV reads are not expected across region hops. We have included representative logs from both us-west and eu-west in the timeline CSV for your verification.

2) Perf impact: the per-session semaphore adds a single fast-path compare-and-set and, under our simulated peak load, increased p99 token latency by ~6ms (non-blocking in 99.8% of cases). We include perf microbench results in the evidence PDF. We do not expect customer-visible tail latency outside these numbers; Marissa can join the verification call to walk through the perf numbers.

3) Signed evidence: attached is a signed confirmation from David Kim (Engineering Lead) with commit hash: a3f9b7d and CI run: ci-2027-12-15-ops-4487. Link to CI artifact: https://ci.internal.redwood/ci-2027-12-15-ops-4487.

We completed the patch deployment to the us-west pool at 14:10 PST 2027-12-15 and the eu-west pool at 15:05 PST 2027-12-15. Hannah has retained the expanded telemetry and exported sanitized traces; download link in the Drive artifact.

Proposed verification call: Fri 17 Dec 2027, 09:30–10:00 PST. Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
